description: This file defines a class 'UserMenuConfigurator' that implements the 'MenuConfigurator' interface. It configures user menu options within the OrangeHRM Admin module by overriding screen behavior for system users.

classes.name: UserMenuConfigurator
classes.description: A class responsible for configuring user menu items, specifically overriding the 'viewSystemUsers' screen.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the current module and screen to 'viewSystemUsers' and returns null.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets the current screen to 'viewSystemUsers' within the provided Screen object.
